formats.checkTitle: Check a Reel against an edit format
formats.checkHelp: Paste an Instagram Reel to read its actual caption and audio label. This check uses no search credits or AI allowance.
formats.checkUnavailable: Instagram did not provide this Reel’s public metadata. The check is inconclusive.
formats.checkLocalOnly: Open localhost:3000 to use the local source and AI checks.
formats.checkFailed: The check could not finish. No visual match was confirmed. Try again or check your selected connection.
formats.framesUnavailable: Video frames could not be read. The clip may be unavailable, over 90 seconds or 12 MB, or the local video decoder may be missing. You can explicitly choose Preview image only.
formats.metadataLimit: A matching song does not establish a matching edit or current popularity. These are source labels; the audio was not listened to.
formats.inspectHelp: ChatGPT can inspect sampled video frames or one preview image. This uses your selected subscription and model only when you press Inspect edit. Video checks support publicly accessible clips up to 90 seconds and 12 MB.
formats.framesLimit: AI assessment of sampled video frames
formats.limitSamples: Only sampled frames were inspected. Fast effects between frames may be missed; complete motion and timing are unverified.
formats.inspectChatgptOnly: This image check currently supports ChatGPT. Select ChatGPT explicitly to use it; your Claude selection will not be switched automatically.
formats.visualMatch: The inspected images show supporting visual clues
formats.visualMismatch: The inspected images show a different visual pattern
formats.visualUnknown: The inspected images are not enough to judge the edit
formats.previewLimit: AI assessment of one preview image
formats.limitThumbnail: Only one static preview was inspected.
formats.limitMotion: Motion and the complete editing sequence were not verified.
formats.limitSync: Audio timing and synchronization were not verified.
formats.checkingSources: Checking captions and audio labels on Instagram…
formats.excludedSources: {n} search leads not supported by the source
formats.excludedHelp: These may still teach related skills. They are kept separate because Instagram’s own metadata did not support the exact format match.
formats.excludedAudio: Instagram displays different audio from this format.
formats.excludedCaption: The actual caption does not support the song and editing pattern claimed by the search excerpt.
formats.publicCaption: Caption and audio label read from the public post. The video has not been analysed.
inspiration.sub: Find an edit that inspires you. Study one technique. Make it your own.
inspiration.title: From inspiration to practice
inspiration.help: Pick one reference, write what you want to try, then make a small version with your own footage.
inspiration.local: Saved on this device and included in your dashboard export.
inspiration.empty: Your next experiment starts with one good reference.
inspiration.emptyHelp: Save a video from Explore. You can keep it here without choosing a skill.
inspiration.noteLabel: What do I want to try?
inspiration.notePlaceholder: For example: match the shape between two shots. Film a cup and a wheel, then line up the cut.
inspiration.filterEmpty: No references at this stage yet.
inspiration.starters: What would you like to try?
inspiration.startersHelp: Start with a technique, or choose a category above to study edits in that subject.
formats.title: 🎵 Edit formats to follow
formats.browseHelp: Choose an edit, find examples, then learn how to make it.
formats.cardUnverified: The audio and edit pairing has not been visually verified.
formats.cardDateUnknown: Post date unknown · current momentum unconfirmed.
formats.help: A specific visual idea and the audio or named format it belongs to. Check the examples, then find a way to make it yours.
formats.local: Following keeps a list on this device, included in your dashboard export. It does not send notifications or monitor your Instagram feed.
formats.evidence: {creators} identified accounts · {posts} indexed posts in the 7 days before the check. Search excerpts suggest this pairing. These are unverified leads: excerpts may include unrelated context, and the actual audio and edit are not confirmed.
formats.reviewedNote: Individually checked reference. Repeated appearance in your feed is a useful lead; wider popularity has not been measured.
formats.partialPlayback: Part of the video was visually checked.
formats.userDescription: Identified from your description; the full video has not been checked.
formats.captionOnly: Indexed search text suggests this pairing. It may include unrelated context; the actual caption, audio and video have not been verified.
formats.dateUnknown: No confirmed post date. Current momentum is unknown.
formats.stale: No fresh evidence for this format yet. Older examples can still be useful references.
formats.awaitingScan: The latest scan has no format-level results yet. Reviewed references and your followed formats remain available.
formats.emptyFollowing: Follow a format to keep its audio and examples together here.
formats.empty: No supported format found yet. A song alone or a generic effect name is not enough to identify one.
formats.scanFailed: The scan couldn't finish. Your followed formats and earlier references are still here.
formats.scanUnavailable: Format detection was unavailable in the latest scan. Earlier references keep their original check dates.
formats.noAutomatic: The latest scan found no supported audio-and-edit pairings. Reviewed references and followed formats are shown below.
formats.searchRules: Reviewed reference links are retained. Other results are unverified leads suggested by indexed search text. Excerpts may include unrelated context; the actual audio and edit are not confirmed.
formats.searchTutorialRules: Unverified tutorial leads: indexed search text suggests this audio and edit. Excerpts may include unrelated context; the actual post caption, audio and visual match are not confirmed.
formats.searchEmpty: No indexed search text clearly suggested both this audio and edit in this view. The reviewed example remains above. Search coverage is incomplete, so matching posts may still exist.
